items.question: Where do the signals and scores come from?
items.answer: From real public sources (LinkedIn, G2, Google Search) and your own pipeline data. If there isn't enough data for a score, the system shows it empty — it never invents a number to make the screen look complete.

items.question: Does BEE send messages on my behalf without me knowing?
items.answer: No. No external action — an email, a LinkedIn message, a sequence — runs without explicit human approval. The system prepares the play; you decide if it goes out.

items.question: Does my data mix with other accounts?
items.answer: No. Organization isolation runs end-to-end through the database and every endpoint — not a flag that can be switched off by mistake.

items.question: What happens if my market isn't generating signals yet?
items.answer: The system shows the real state: empty spaces where there's no signal, instead of filling in with sample data. We'd rather show an honest panel than one that looks active without being active.

items.question: How do I get started?
items.answer: Reach out through the Contact form — we respond within 24 business hours to coordinate the first step.
